categories.name: Song library
categories.blurb: Every chord sheet in one place, easy to find.

features.title: ChordPro at the core
features.desc: Songs are stored as standard ChordPro text, readable by other apps and by you.

features.title: Full song details
features.desc: Artist, subtitle, composer, lyricist, copyright, CCLI numbers, tempo, time signature and duration.

features.title: Custom fields
features.desc: Add your own named fields to any song, and search finds them too.

features.title: Smart search
features.desc: Search titles, artists and lyrics at once, with the matching lines shown.

features.title: Sort and group
features.desc: Sort by title, artist, key or newest, and group the list by letter.

features.title: A to Z scrubber
features.desc: Jump through a long list by dragging along the alphabet at its edge.

features.title: Coloured tags
features.desc: Tag songs with colours and filter the library by tag.

features.title: Hidden tags
features.desc: Keep seasonal songs out of the list until you filter for them.

features.title: Song icons
features.desc: Give a song a small icon to spot it at a glance in lists and setlists.

features.title: Multiple libraries
features.desc: Keep separate libraries for church, band or teaching, and switch in a tap.

features.title: Trash bin
features.desc: Deleted songs wait in the trash, ready to restore or delete for good.

features.title: Swipe between songs
features.desc: Swipe sideways with a finger or two-finger trackpad gesture to the next song.

features.title: Drag and drop
features.desc: Drop song files, PDFs, pictures or media onto the window to add them.

features.title: PDF and picture songs
features.desc: Add a PDF or photo as a song of its own, or attach it to a ChordPro song.

features.title: PDF view options
features.desc: Crop page margins, show whole pages, or tint sheets to match the theme.

features.title: Reference links
features.desc: Attach a YouTube or audio link to each song and play it in a floating player.

features.title: Key detection
features.desc: The song's key is worked out from its chords when you haven't set one.

features.title: Right-to-left lyrics
features.desc: Hebrew, Arabic and other right-to-left lines read correctly, even mixed with left-to-right.

categories.name: Song editor
categories.blurb: Write and fix songs quickly, with tools made for chords.

features.title: ChordPro editor
features.desc: Edit the song text with chords in brackets, plus a details tab and a chord beats tab.

features.title: Chord typing helpers
features.desc: Buttons insert brackets, sharps, flats and slash chords without hunting for symbols.

features.title: Find and replace
features.desc: Search the song text with match case, next and previous, and replace.

features.title: Paste chords over words
features.desc: Paste a song copied from any website and the chords are placed into ChordPro for you.

features.title: Rewrite into key
features.desc: Rewrite the chords permanently into another key with one action.

features.title: Written key and capo
features.desc: Record the key the song is written in and the capo position.

features.title: Inline text styles
features.desc: Make lyrics bold, italic, underlined, coloured, highlighted or larger with simple marks.

features.title: Strum patterns
features.desc: Write a strum pattern in the song and it is drawn as up and down strokes.

features.title: Guitar and ukulele tabs
features.desc: Tab blocks are drawn as clean strings with frets, or kept as typed.

features.title: Tab playback
features.desc: Press play on a tab to hear it at the song's tempo, with a marker following.

features.title: ABC sheet music
features.desc: Write a melody in ABC notation and see it engraved as real sheet music.

features.title: Melody playback
features.desc: Play an ABC melody with a piano sound right from the chord sheet.

features.title: Keyboard save
features.desc: Save the song with Ctrl+S without leaving the keyboard.

categories.name: Chords your way
categories.blurb: Play any song in any key, with the chord names you read best.

features.title: One-tap transpose
features.desc: Transpose up or down by semitones, per song or per setlist entry.

features.title: Capo
features.desc: Set a capo and the chord shapes change to match, right from the bottom bar.

features.title: Chord notations
features.desc: Show chords as letters, Nashville numbers, Roman numerals or solfège.

features.title: Dual chords
features.desc: Show a second notation beside each chord, such as G (1).

features.title: Minor chord style
features.desc: Write minors as m, mi, min, a dash or lower case.

features.title: Sharps or flats
features.desc: Spell accidentals automatically, or always as sharps or always as flats.

features.title: Chords above or inline
features.desc: Place chords above the lyrics or inline within the words.

features.title: Chord diagrams
features.desc: Guitar, ukulele and piano diagrams for every chord in the song.

features.title: Tap a chord
features.desc: Tap any chord in the sheet to see how to play it.

features.title: Hear a chord
features.desc: Tap a diagram to hear the chord strummed or played on piano.

features.title: Strum speed
features.desc: Choose a fast, medium or slow strum when chords play.

features.title: Finger numbers and zoom
features.desc: Show or hide finger numbers and resize the diagrams.

features.title: Chord library
features.desc: Browse every shape, choose your preferred voicing for each chord.

features.title: Make your own shape
features.desc: Create custom chord shapes for frets or piano keys and save them.

features.title: Chord beats
features.desc: Show how many beats each chord lasts, set by tapping chords.

features.title: Beat styles
features.desc: Draw beats as dots, stacks, pills or a timeline, with bars per line.

categories.name: Setlists and arrangements
categories.blurb: Plan every service and gig, and build the order you actually play.

features.title: Setlists
features.desc: Gather songs into setlists and reorder them by dragging.

features.title: Dates and notes
features.desc: Give each setlist a name, event date and notes.

features.title: Dividers, labels and events
features.desc: Mark moments like After Sermon or Maybe between songs.

features.title: Set-specific edits
features.desc: Keys, capo and arrangements changed in a setlist stay in that setlist.

features.title: Nested songs
features.desc: Nest a song under another so they play together as a medley.

features.desc: Add pictures, videos, audio or YouTube links that play when the set reaches them.

features.title: Scripture in setlists
features.desc: Save Bible passages into a setlist, ready to show in order.

features.title: Per-song backgrounds
features.desc: Choose a different projector background for a song in a setlist.

features.title: Export a setlist
features.desc: Export a whole setlist as a songbook, slides or for other apps.

features.title: Structure editor
features.desc: Build the arrangement by tapping sections and dragging to reorder.

features.title: Repeat sections
features.desc: Use a chorus or bridge as many times as the arrangement needs.

features.title: Key changes
features.desc: Raise or lower any section by semitones for modulations.

features.title: Linked sections
features.desc: Link two sections so they show together on one slide.

features.title: Follow arrangement
features.desc: Play the sheet and slides in arrangement order, or as written.

features.title: Section labels
features.desc: Labels like Verse 1 or Chorus are recognised and turned into sections.

features.title: Per-setlist arrangements
features.desc: Give a song a different structure in one setlist without changing the song.

categories.name: Tools on stage
categories.blurb: The things you reach for mid-song, one tap away.

features.title: Ambient pads

features.title: SoundFont pads

features.title: Floating player

features.title: Quick buttons
features.desc: Choose which tools appear in the bottom bar.

features.title: Customizable toolbar
features.desc: Reorder toolbar buttons or tuck them into the More menu.

features.title: Keyboard and pedal control

features.title: Full screen tools

categories.name: Notes, ink and pictures

features.title: Sticky notes

features.desc: Select drawn strokes to move or resize them.

features.title: Picture tools

categories.name: Sheet music scanner
categories.blurb: Photograph printed music, then hear it, fix it and export it.

features.title: Score exports

features.title: Scan library
